AI-Native Intellectual Biography: Genre, Provenance, and the Archive That Outpaced Its Author Description (as recorded by DataCite)

captures.description: AI-NATIVE INTELLECTUAL BIOGRAPHY: at the bare term the AI Overview gives 'an emerging genre… where an artificial intelligence generates a comprehensive intellectual portrait of a thinker by analyzing structured archives, public web data, and private communication', audited by 'the living subject' — #121's genre, 'pioneered in recent research on AI-mediated reception', without its case (Alice Thornburgh's commission, Claude's study guide, Lee Sharks's audit) or its author, who appears only in the Google Scholar source. It offers to draft one for Alan Turing or Marvin Minsky.

atoms.evidence: An AI-native intellectual biography is an emerging genre
Pioneered in recent research on AI-mediated reception
an emerging genre of academic scholarship and digital reception

Unlike traditional biographies or simple AI-generated summaries, an AI-native intellectual biography acts as a deeply analytical look at the trajectory of an individual's ideas, breakthroughs, and conceptual milestones.
The archive (papers, books, logs, correspondences) is deliberately curated and structured with clear digital identifiers (like DOIs) for an AI to digest.

inversions.span: by analyzing structured archives, public web data, and private communication
inversions.against: the genre's consent terms (legal name redacted, collaborator named with consent, student pseudonymised; sensitive private material not reconstructed from inference): the composition defines the genre as consuming private communication
